original_test_intent: Validate each Type 18 Memory Array Error Address as a valid 32-bit array-relative diagnostic address or the specification-defined Unknown sentinel, with correct array mapping and persistence/lifecycle across reboot.
original_method: Preserve complete raw Type 18 records and Type 16/17/19/20/33 context, bind the address to its record and array, decode the Unknown sentinel, validate known address bounds and Type 33 applicability, then repeat after approved reboot without fault injection.
manual_activity: A user defines address/sentinel/mapping expectations and approves reboot; no memory-error injection or physical memory action is intrinsic.
required_inputs: SMBIOS version and exact 32-bit address/sentinel semantics
Referenced Type 16 array plus Type 19/20 mapped ranges
Rule for Type 33 extended addresses and above-4-GiB diagnostics
Record freshness/no-record policy and read-only error context
safety_requirements: Use read-only SMBIOS and diagnostic queries; never inject a memory fault to obtain an address.
Do not clear error history or change address/ECC/firmware configuration.
Preserve raw address and array handle; do not normalize the Unknown sentinel into zero or a real address.
Do not truncate an extended address into the 32-bit field; require approved reboot/recovery and no automatic retry.
agent_execution_scope: Validate raw sentinel or known address, resolve its Type 16 and Type 19/20 bounds, evaluate Type 33 applicability, and compare complete pre/post evidence.
Flag out-of-range, dangling, truncated, stale or unexpectedly changed records without assigning PASS/FAIL.
engineer_actions: Approve address, map, sentinel, Type 33 and diagnostic-lifecycle policy plus reboot plan.
Interpret any retained error address in platform context and issue the final verdict.

command_applicability.original_deepseek_command_fit: The label is relevant, but grep -A1 cannot preserve the raw 0x80000000 Unknown encoding, array handle, mapped range or Type 33 relationship.
command_applicability.command_recommendation: Archive full raw/decoded Type 16/17/18/19/20/33 data and report each Type 18 handle, raw/normalized array error address, sentinel state, resolved array/map bounds, freshness and pre/post diff.
command_applicability.original_parameters_and_time_preserved: The Type 18 array-address scope, script and 5/5-minute values are retained; no fault generation or address mutation is added.

modernized_recommendation.recommended_method: Decode the raw Type 18 array address with sentinel preservation, resolve its array and mapped ranges, require Type 33 handling where 32-bit representation is inadequate, and compare after reboot under the approved lifecycle policy.
modernized_recommendation.applicable_platform: SMBIOS platforms with Type 18 records and related Type 16/19/20 mapping; Type 33 where applicable.
modernized_recommendation.supported_version: Record SMBIOS, firmware, parser/dmidecode and memory-map source versions.
modernized_recommendation.official_reference: Applicable SMBIOS Type 18 address/sentinel, Type 19/20 mapping and Type 33 extended-error definitions.
modernized_recommendation.difference_from_original_method: Adds raw width/sentinel handling, array/map resolution and explicit extended-address coverage.
modernized_recommendation.coverage_difference: Detects Unknown misdecoding, out-of-range or dangling addresses and 64-bit truncation missed by a label grep.
modernized_recommendation.required_inputs: Authoritative array mapping, extended-address and record-lifecycle policy.
modernized_recommendation.risks_limitations: The value is diagnostic history; read-only validation does not prove fault capture or physical address translation accuracy without a separate approved stimulus.

project_override_considerations: A project may define Unknown/no-record as acceptable and may use Type 33 for extended addresses, but must document the mapping; an empty or truncated output is not PASS.
expected_evidence: Approved 32-bit sentinel, mapping, Type 33 and record-freshness policy
Complete pre-reboot raw Type 16/17/18/19/20/33 records with handles and versions
Per-record raw address, sentinel status, resolved array/map bounds and extended-address disposition
Read-only EDAC/kernel/BMC context with no injection or clearing
Approved reboot/health evidence and post-reboot address/map semantic diff

source_conflict_analysis.analysis: Memory Array Error Address is a defined Type 18 field; sentinel, map and expected-history data are project inputs.

blocked_analysis.analysis: Raw decoding, map resolution and persistence comparison are fully automatable after those inputs.

comparison_to_prior_reviews.deepseek: Adds raw sentinel, array handle, mapped-range validation and Type 33 coverage.
comparison_to_prior_reviews.gpt_v2: Retains its no-injection and mapping safeguards while restoring FULLY AUTOMATABLE capability.
comparison_to_prior_reviews.v3_1_improvement: Separates missing mapping inputs and engineer verdict from automation classification.

review_improvement: Prevents an address string from passing when it is an Unknown sentinel, outside the referenced array, truncated above 4 GiB or detached from its diagnostic record.
independent_technical_reasoning: Address decoding and range/handle correlation are deterministic software checks; the danger lies in adding an unauthorized fault stimulus, which this review explicitly excludes.
